flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsRefundNotices (entity), ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsRefundNotice (entity, controller /refundnotice dan /refundnoticelist), workflows/furnish/plusintegration/controllers/PlusDataRetrievalController, api-authorization.properties; ocmsadminui App.tsx (route refund dikomentari). thirdpartyapi: tidak ada interface Cumulus
note: Status 'Replacement Story'. The story asks OCMS to receive the refund status from Cumulus (successful/unsuccessful) with a failure reason (e.g. invalid bank account number). The word 'cumulus' does not appear in the six repos, there is no endpoint/SFTP/callback that receives a refund status, and table ocms_refund_notice has no status or failure-reason column; refund_reason is only the reason code for creating the refund (PSR/DBP/OVP/APP) per ticket OCMS-SR-2026-157. refundStatus appears only as an example in the Javadoc of PlusDataRetrievalController, not in the entity. The staff UI refund routes (Epic46) are commented out in App.tsx. Related ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-152 (refundNoticeId returned to PLUS; the code on main already returns the real ID, ticket status 'Ready to DEV', deployment cannot verify from repo). A Cumulus interface outside the repo (e.g. in a Finance system) cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim. The repo has no Cumulus interface, no status intake and no storage for a failure reason.

steps.step: The refund advice has been interfaced from OCMS to Cumulus (story precondition)
steps.detail: Case-insensitive grep for 'cumulus' in the six repos = 0 hits; thirdpartyapi and ocmsadminprivateapi have no refund sender (file/API/SFTP) to Finance. The refund entity only stores the record (OcmsRefundNotices.java:20-58).

steps.step: OCMS receives the refund status from Cumulus (successful/unsuccessful)
steps.detail: The only authorized refund endpoint is /v1/refundnoticelist (list, api-authorization.properties:36) plus POST /refundnotice and /refundnoticelist in OcmsRefundNoticeController.java:43,76 (plain CRUD). No endpoint, cron or file watcher for a status from Cumulus.

steps.step: OCMS receives the reason when the refund fails (e.g. invalid bank account number)
steps.detail: refund_reason length 3 (OcmsRefundNotices.java:57-58) holds the reason code for creating the refund (PSR/DBP/OVP/APP, see OCMS-SR-2026-157), not a payout failure reason. No column or field for a failure reason from Cumulus.

steps.step: Status and reason are stored on the refund record so the officer can follow up
steps.detail: The entity has no status column (OcmsRefundNotice.java:27-58). The staff UI refund routes (Epic46) sit inside the commented JSX block App.tsx:342-371 and the Epic46 import is commented out at :60. refundStatus is only a Javadoc example in PlusDataRetrievalController.java:47. Refunds are visible only through the daily Payment Exception Report and /refundnoticelist, without any Cumulus status.
